activity.notes: Ali Hassan Mwinyi was elected President of Zanzibar in 1984 and served in that office before becoming President of the United Republic of Tanzania on 5 November 1985. ATLAS records the Zanzibar presidency as a distinct constituent-polity Activity rather than folding it into his later Tanzanian presidency.

sources.title: Ali Hassan Mwinyi — Office of the President of Tanzania
sources.citation_text: The official Tanzanian presidential biography states that Mwinyi was elected President of Zanzibar in 1984 and became President of the United Republic of Tanzania on 5 November 1985.
